followup: During that run, collection failed 348 separate times. The collector gathered 2930 test items in total, whereas the framework's genuine suite contains 2156 of them — meaning an extra 774 tests were pulled in from the projects/ checkouts belonging to three different bots. The whole attempt took 307 seconds of wall-clock time. Once the change was applied, the set of collected node IDs matched byte for byte.
